chunks: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
'Can the earth happen to be such that there is no Imam in it?' He said: 'No.'
I said: 'Can there be two Imams (at the same time)?' He said: 'No, except that one of the two would be silent.'

key_terms.إمام: Imam — the divinely appointed leader with authority over religious and worldly affairs
key_terms.الأرض: The earth — meaning the inhabited world, implying it always requires a divinely guided leader
key_terms.صامت: Silent (samit) — the Imam who does not openly exercise authority, referring to a designated successor during his predecessor's lifetime

ai.seo_question: Can the earth ever be without an Imam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Ala' reports asking Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) two fundamental questions about the imamate: whether the earth can ever be without an Imam, and whether two Imams can simultaneously hold authority. The Imam categorically denied both possibilities, but clarified that if two exist simultaneously, one must necessarily be silent — referring to the practice of the designated successor who refrains from openly exercising authority until his time comes. This hadith establishes the cardinal Shia doctrine that the earth is never devoid of a divinely appointed authority (hujja), and that the imamate is a singular, not shared, office.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can the earth happen to be and there isn’t an Imam<sup>asws</sup> in it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
I said, ‘Can there happen to be two Imams<sup>asws</sup> (at the same time)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, except that one of the two would be silent’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Husayn ibn abu al-‘Ala’ who has said the following. “I
abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘Can there be a time on earth without Imam?” The Imam said, “No, it can not be without Imam.”
I asked, “Can there be two Imams at a time?” He said, “No, unless one is quite.”
